+
+def test_get_task_status_success(client):
+    r_post = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Status Test Task"})
+    assert r_post.status_code == 201
+    task_id = r_post.json()["id"]
+
+    r_status = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}/status")
+    assert r_status.status_code == 200
+    assert r_status.json() == {"id": task_id, "status": "todo"}
+
+def test_get_task_status_not_found(client):
+    r = client.get("/tasks/999999/status")
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert "not found" in r.json().get("detail", "").lower()
+
+def test_get_task_status_validation_error(client):
+    r = client.get("/tasks/not-an-integer/status")
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+
+def test_get_task_status_readonly(client):
+    r_post = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Readonly Status Test"})
+    task_id = r_post.json()["id"]
+
+    r1 = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}/status")
+    assert r1.status_code == 200
+
+    r2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
+    assert r2.status_code == 200
+    assert r2.json()["status"] == "todo"
+    assert r2.json()["title"] == "Readonly Status Test"
